reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    State: Idaho
    Focus year: 2021
    Question: Does state/territory eviction law explicitly regulate corporate landlords?
*/

/* =========================
   Scenario facts (question)
   ========================= */

scenario_state(idaho).
scenario_focus_year(2021).
scenario_question(does_eviction_law_explicitly_regulate_corporate_landlords).

/* The "statement" being evaluated: we are examining Idaho eviction law in 2021. */
scenario_statement :-
    scenario_state(idaho),
    scenario_focus_year(2021),
    scenario_question(does_eviction_law_explicitly_regulate_corporate_landlords).

/* =========================
   Statute encodings
   ========================= */

/* ---------------------------------------------------------
   ID Code  6-316 (2021) - Judgment / restitution timelines
   --------------------------------------------------------- */

/*  6-316(1): If verdict/finding favors plaintiff -> restitution of premises. */
statute_6_316_judgment_requires_restitution(plaintiff_wins) :- !.

/*  6-316(1): If proceeding is unlawful detainer after certain grounds -> forfeiture declared. */
statute_6_316_judgment_declares_forfeiture_if_unlawful_detainer_ground(default_in_payment_of_rent) :- !.
statute_6_316_judgment_declares_forfeiture_if_unlawful_detainer_ground(neglect_or_failure_to_perform_lease_covenants) :- !.
statute_6_316_judgment_declares_forfeiture_if_unlawful_detainer_ground(controlled_substance_activity_reasonable_grounds) :- !.

/*  6-316(1): For certain >5 acre rent-default cases, execution delayed 5 days and tenant may cure by paying. */
statute_6_316_stay_of_execution_applies(land_acres(Acres), proceeding_unlawful_detainer_after_default_in_rent, lease_not_expired_by_terms) :-
    number(Acres),
    Acres > 5,
    !.

statute_6_316_stay_period_days(5) :- !.

/*  6-316(2): Time to remove belongings depends on tenant type / acreage. */
statute_6_316_time_to_remove_belongings_hours(residential_tenant, 72) :- !.
statute_6_316_time_to_remove_belongings_days(commercial_tenant, 7) :- !.
statute_6_316_time_to_remove_belongings_days(tenant_with_tract_5_acres_or_more, 7) :- !.

/*  6-316(2): Landlord or his agents may deliver writ / request sheriff deliver writ. */
statute_6_316_writ_delivery_allowed_by(landlord) :- !.
statute_6_316_writ_delivery_allowed_by(landlord_agent) :- !.

/* NOTE:  6-316 uses "landlord" and "agents" but does not explicitly mention corporations/companies
   as landlords, nor create special rules for corporate landlords specifically. */

/* ---------------------------------------------------------
   ID Code  55-2003 (2021) - Definitions (manufactured home communities)
   --------------------------------------------------------- */

/*  55-2003(6): "Landlord" means owner/lessor/sublessor/operator, includes agents. */
statute_55_2003_landlord_role(owner) :- !.
statute_55_2003_landlord_role(lessor) :- !.
statute_55_2003_landlord_role(sublessor) :- !.
statute_55_2003_landlord_role(operator) :- !.
statute_55_2003_landlord_includes_agents(true) :- !.

/*  55-2003(8): "Manager" includes any company chosen by the landlord to administer/supervise. */
statute_55_2003_manager_includes_company(true) :- !.

/* ---------------------------------------------------------
   ID Code  55-2704 (2021) - Definitions (floating home moorage)
   --------------------------------------------------------- */

/*  55-2704(3): "Landlord" means owner of floating home marina and includes agent. */
statute_55_2704_landlord_role(owner_of_floating_home_marina) :- !.
statute_55_2704_landlord_includes_agents(true) :- !.

/* =========================
   Domain model / reasoning
   ========================= */

/* Identify which provided statute(s) are eviction-law rules for this question.
   (Here,  6-316 is the explicit eviction/unlawful detainer judgment/restitution statute.) */
eviction_law_statute(id_code_6_316_2021) :- !.

/* Determine whether an eviction-law statute explicitly regulates corporate landlords.

   Interpretation encoded:
   - "Explicitly regulate corporate landlords" requires the eviction-law statute itself
     to mention corporate/organizational forms (e.g., corporation, company, LLC) as landlords
     or create rules specifically triggered by a landlord being a corporation/company.

   The encoded  6-316 rules do not mention corporation/company/LLC, and do not distinguish
   corporate vs. individual landlords.

   (Definitions in other chapters mentioning "company" for "manager" are not an eviction-law
    rule and also do not define "landlord" as a company.)
*/
statute_explicitly_regulates_corporate_landlords(id_code_6_316_2021) :-
    % If we had an explicit corporate trigger, it would be encoded here.
    % For 2021 Idaho  6-316 as provided, there is none.
    fail.

/* Global query: does Idaho eviction law (as encoded here) explicitly regulate corporate landlords? */
eviction_law_explicitly_regulates_corporate_landlords(State, Year) :-
    State = idaho,
    Year = 2021,
    eviction_law_statute(StatuteId),
    statute_explicitly_regulates_corporate_landlords(StatuteId),
    !.

/* =========================
   Answer
   ========================= */

housing_answer(yes) :-
    scenario_statement,
    eviction_law_explicitly_regulates_corporate_landlords(idaho, 2021),
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    scenario_statement,
    \+ eviction_law_explicitly_regulates_corporate_landlords(idaho, 2021),
    !.

/* =========================
   Main entrypoint
   ========================= */

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Does state/territory eviction law explicitly regulate corporate landlords?
